effects.description: After holding down the normal attack button during the 1st hit of a normal attack combo: The 2nd hit of the attack changes, and the character either transforms or reverts to their human form after the attack. Transforming into their Awakened Form changes their class to Attacker and increases their ATK by 30% for 20 seconds (Cannot Stack). Undoing their Awakened Form changes their class to Runner and increases their SPD by 10% for 20 seconds (Cannot Stack).

skills.detail: Creates a marker at mid-range that only you can see. The marker can be moved while the skill button is held down. You will be moved to the marker's location and the marker will disappear after a certain period of time or when the skill button is released. Also unleashes a mid-range area attack with a Knockback effect. Damage dealt will change based on the enemies' HP. This will deal a fixed percentage of damage and will not increase due to a critical hit. Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time. Acquires ATK debuff effect at Level 5.
